Name: Oops - Skill Based Mistakes and Progression
Author: AnnaCharles
Description:
[center][b][size=6]Oops![/size][/b][/center]
[center][i]Grandpa gave you a farm.[/i][/center]
[center][i]He just forgot one tiny detail...[/i][/center]
[center][i]You have absolutely no idea what you're doing.[/i][/center]
[center][i]And now you own several acres of land.[/i][/center]
[center][i]Good luck.[/i][/center]

[center][b]Oops![/b] adds a lightweight skill-based mistake system to Stardew Valley where your farmer actually feels inexperienced when they first arrive in the valley.[/center]
[center]You’ll miss swings, spill water, get nervous around monsters, react too slowly when a fish finally bites, mishandle animal products, and sometimes accidentally upset your animals.[/center]
[center]But don’t worry.[/center]
[center]The more experienced your farmer becomes, the better they get.[/center]
[center]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b]A little support goes a long way.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b] Endorsements, comments, and feedback help these mods grow and inspire what comes next.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[color=#f1c232][size=1][font=Verdana][b] Thanks for being part of it.[/b][/font][/size][/color]
[/center]



🌱 [b]NEWBIE TO PRO[/b]
Oops! follows your farmer’s permanent skill levels in:
[b]Farming • Mining • Foraging • Fishing • Combat[/b]
As your skills increase, mistakes become less frequent or less severe.
At higher Combat levels, fear fades completely and can even turn into a small speed boost.
At [b]Level 10[/b], you’ve mastered that skill, Farmer.


🛠️ [b]FARM TOOLS[/b]
Using tools when you’re inexperienced can sometimes go a little... wrong.
[b]Axe[/b]
Sometimes you completely miss your target.
[b]Oops.[/b]
[b]Hoe[/b]
Miss the ground you were trying to till.
[b]Oops.[/b]
[b]Watering Can[/b]
At very low Farming levels, you can fumble badly enough to spill the whole can and need a refill. As you improve, mistakes become less severe.
[b]Oops.[/b]
[b]Pickaxe[/b]
Mishandle the pickaxe?
OUCH.
[b]Oops.[/b]
As your relevant skill improves, these mistakes become less common until mastery removes them.


🐄 [b]ANIMAL CARE[/b]
Animal care also improves with Farming experience.
At very low Farming levels, you can mishandle an animal product badly enough to lose it and accidentally upset the animal in the process.
[b]“Oops, sorry [Animal Name]... I didn't mean to do that.”[/b]
At higher Farming levels, mistakes become less severe. You might simply drop the product and be able to pick it back up.
Eventually, the mistakes disappear completely.


🎣 [b]FISHING[/b]
Oops! does not interfere with casting or the fishing minigame.
Instead, the mistake happens at the worst possible moment.
You cast.
You wait.
You finally see:
[b]![/b]
And then...
[b]Oops.[/b]
Your farmer reacts too slowly and the fish gets away before the minigame even begins.
Your bobber stays in the water, and you have to wait for another bite.
The better your Fishing skill becomes, the less often this happens.
At [b]Fishing Level 10[/b], the mistake disappears entirely.


⚔️ [b]COMBAT[/b]
Combat works a little differently.
Your farmer isn’t missing attacks or dealing random damage.
They’re simply [b]afraid[/b].
When hostile monsters get close, inexperienced farmers become nervous and immediately forget how legs work.
As Combat improves, that fear fades.
Eventually, it becomes confidence.
[table][tr][th]Combat Level[/th]
[th]Effect[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]0–2[/b][/td]
[td]-2 Speed[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]3–4[/b][/td]
[td]-1 Speed[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]5–7[/b][/td]
[td]Normal movement[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]8–9[/b][/td]
[td]+1 Speed[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]10+[/b][/td]
[td]+2 Speed[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]Only one Oops! Combat effect can exist at a time.
Standing near ten monsters doesn’t give you ten penalties.
Once the danger is gone, the Oops! Combat effect disappears.
⏳ [b]OOPS COOLDOWN[/b]
After an Oops!, you get a [b]2 in-game hour grace period[/b] before another mistake can happen.
Mistakes are meant to add personality and unpredictability — not constantly interrupt everything you do.


💚 [b]FORGIVING MISTAKES[/b]
Want the personality of Oops! without quite as much suffering?
Enable:
[b]Forgiving Mistakes[/b]
This option is [b]OFF by default[/b].
When enabled:
[list]
[*]Bucket Drop can still happen, but your watering can is not emptied[/*]
[*]Early Animal Care mistakes can still upset the animal, but the product is not destroyed[/*]
[/list]You still get the mistake and reaction without the harsher resource loss.


🦆 [b]WHY OOPS!?[/b]
I wanted skill levels to feel like more than numbers.
A brand-new farmer shouldn’t necessarily feel identical to someone who has spent years farming, mining, fishing, and fighting monsters.
Oops! adds that little period where your farmer is still figuring things out.
You make mistakes.
You waste some time.
You embarrass yourself.
Sometimes you hear a duck.
And slowly...
[b]you get better.[/b]



📦 [b]REQUIREMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b][/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b][/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — Optional[/*]
[/list]

💡 [b]COMPATIBILITY / GAMEPLAY CLARIFICATION[/b]
Oops! is built around [b]Stardew Valley and SMAPI’s normal runtime systems[/b] and does not depend on any other mod’s content.
Its mistake system uses gameplay information already available through Stardew Valley, including player skill levels, tool use, watering, fishing bites, animal interactions, hostile monsters, movement, stamina, and friendship effects.
[b]Oops! only applies its gameplay effects to the player’s own actions, movement, tools, fishing, and animal interactions.[/b]
These effects can include stamina loss, temporary movement changes, spilled water, dropped or lost animal products, and small animal friendship changes.
It does not edit, replace, or redistribute tool files, animal files, monster files, sprites, dialogue, maps, code, assets, or other source content.
Mistake chances, severity, cooldowns, skill thresholds, and recovery behaviour are controlled by [b]the mod’s own programmed rules and randomisation[/b].
[b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is supported.

🤖 [b]AI DISCLOSURE[/b]
The [b]AI-Generated Content[/b] tag reflects the use of AI assistance during development of Oops!, including development of the mod’s code.
The mod itself was designed, tested, balanced, adjusted, and assembled by me.
[b]Oops! does not use AI, an LLM, or any other generative system while Stardew Valley is running.[/b]
Mistakes are selected through predefined skill rules, probabilities, cooldowns, and programmed randomisation.
AI does not generate mistakes, dialogue, animal behaviour, monster behaviour, tool behaviour, responses, or other gameplay content at runtime.
[b]Oops! uses Stardew Valley’s existing visual and audio feedback for its gameplay effects. No AI-generated art is included.[/b]
